styleLock.direction: cool editorial print-shop menswear board commerce: two hard-edged flat boards, one top display band, one cut-corner label plate, ink-graphite lettering and a single lime pip rail
styleLock.backgroundSystem: two alternating flat printed boards only: a pale iris-grey laminate field #E7E3EC and a deep petrol #16333B field carrying one iris-grey insert panel with a raw cut edge; the field always stays a flat board plane, never a street, room or in-store backdrop, never a fabric or bedding ground, never a dot matrix or tile grid print, never a gradient
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool 5600K studio light entering from the upper right, one broad soft key with a negative fill card on the left, a thin crisp shadow along the garment edge, fabric texture read by a soft skimming fill; no warm cast, no softbox bloom, no mirror specular
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte laminated board sheets with one blind-embossed hairline rule and a visible raw cut paper edge, laid one sheet deep on a flat plane; no wood grain, no stone slab, no floor perspective, no textile surface
styleLock.typography: one wide condensed grotesque display line held on a horizontal rail, paired with a light sans label face; copy budget is one display line plus at most three short labels per screen and every readable line arrives later as a placeholder; no serif, no script, no brush lettering, no vertical type column, no latin slogan row
styleLock.iconSystem: three hairline updraft curl glyphs rising off the knit face, small solid lime #BFD63C square index pips on a hairline rail, and one blank cut-corner plate, all at one stroke weight; no filled medallion, no shield, no cloud badge, no burst tag, no pictogram, no QR block
styleLock.presentationRules: one frontal garment registration and one consistent garment scale across the whole set; collar, drawcord tips, pouch opening and hem rib keep the same proportion screen to screen; the display band holds the top edge only and never overlaps the shoulder line; the chest graphic area always stays one blank rectangular image slot
noDrift: no colour changes beyond #16333B, #E7E3EC, #24262B and #BFD63C plus one product-matched neutral
no serif, script, brush or retro lettering and no second display face
no scenic, outdoor, shop-interior, bedding or gradient ground on any screen
no warm amber cast, no bloom and no mirrored specular highlight on the knit
no QR block, no membership plate, no shop corner badge and no printed price row
no cloned garment, no duplicated seam and no floating hem without a contact shadow
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool editorial menswear print-board system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a pale iris-grey laminate field #E7E3EC, a deep petrol display ground #16333B, ink-graphite lettering #24262B and one lime #BFD63C accent plus one product-matched neutral; cool 5600K studio light entering from the upper right with a negative fill on the left, one thin crisp edge shadow and a soft skimming fill for fabric texture; flat two-tone laminated boards with a blind-embossed hairline rule and a raw cut paper edge, never a scenic, outdoor or gradient background and never a fabric, bedding or dot-matrix ground; one wide condensed grotesque display line on a horizontal rail with a light sans label face, no serif, no script, no brush lettering, no vertical type column; hairline updraft curl glyphs and solid square index pips as the only icon language; stable frontal garment registration and consistent scale on every screen; no colour changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
